desc: 墨黑身片配豹纹插肩袖，白墙庭院度假叙事承载宽松版型
leaf: 女式豹纹插肩拼色宽松短袖T恤
name: 豹纹插肩拼色宽松短袖款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，交代黑身豹纹袖的拼色记忆点。
一秒说清百搭通勤属性，用夹包姿态把上衣放进出门场景。
把上衣放进度假小院的真实光线里，让买家代入夏日出行穿搭。
用插肩斜缝与豹纹纱面微距证明拼接做工，替代口头品质承诺。
用整片后背与落肩垂坠证明宽松不挑人，消除尺码疑虑。
收口促单，用一眼可读的整套平铺搭配给出直接下单的穿搭答案。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless soft white #FFFFFF sweep for the studio frames, sunlit white stucco courtyard with olive greenery and a black lantern arm as the recurring resort stage, pale sand tile floor beneath, no dark studio floors
style.direction: easy resort-day raglan tee commerce with animal-print accent sleeves
style.iconSystem: none; the set carries no icon language, structure comes from the raglan seam lines only
style.lightingSystem: bright diffused daylight near 5500K, open shadowless fill in studio frames, dappled warm sun through leaves in courtyard frames, one soft rim along the shoulder seam, never moody low-key
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent easy resort-day raglan tee ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of ink black body #1A1A1E, leopard cream #E9DCC8, amber rosette #B9834F and washed denim #8FA3B5; bright diffused daylight near 5500K, shadowless in studio frames and dappled warm sun through leaves in courtyard frames with one soft rim along the shoulder seam; seamless white sweep plus a sunlit white stucco courtyard with olive greenery, a black lantern arm and pale sand tiles, no dark studio floors, no marble; model always cropped from the chin down, body panel solid ink black with leopard confined to the raglan sleeves, tee worn loose and untucked over washed denim; no rendered copy, no icon language; no color palette changes, no mixed placements of the print, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no face or identity of the model
no leopard on the body panel
style.presentationRules: the body panel stays solid ink black while only the raglan sleeves carry the leopard print, model cropped from the chin down in every frame, tee always worn loose and untucked over washed denim, hands relaxed mid-gesture never covering the sleeve seam
style.surfaceSystem: matte white wall, pale sand stone tiles, washed denim shorts hem, suede clutch texture as the only prop surface, no marble, no gym equipment
style.typography: no rendered copy in any frame; if a text slot is added it stays an empty placeholder rail
